verses.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਦਿਤੇ ਵੇਦ ਚਾਰ ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਆਸਰਮ ਉਪਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: brahame dhite vedh chaar chaar varan aasaram upajaae|

en.bdb: Brahma gave four Vedas and created four vamas and four stages of life (brahmchary, grihasth, vanaprasth and sannyas).

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਛਿਅ ਸਾਸਤਾ ਛਿਅ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਭੇਸ ਵਰਤਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: chhia dharasan chhia saasataa chhia upadhes bhes varataae|

en.bdb: He created the six phi­losophies, their six texts. teachings and their corresponding sects.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾਂ ਦੀਪ ਸਤ ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਦਹਦਿਸਿ ਵੰਡ ਵੰਡਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: chaare ku(n)ddaa(n) dheep sat nau kha(n)dd dhahadhis va(n)dd va(n)ddaae|

en.bdb: He dis­tributed the whole world into the four corners, seven continents, nine divi­sions and ten directions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਵਣ ਖੰਡ ਪਰਬਤਾਂ ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਵ ਸਥਾਨ ਬਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: jal thal van kha(n)dd parabataa(n) teerath dhev sathaan banaae|

en.bdb: Water, earth, forests, mountains, pilgrimage cen­tres and the abodes of gods were created.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਨ ਕਰਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: jap tap sa(n)jam hom jag karam dharam kar dhaan karaae|

en.bdb: He made the traditions of recitations, ascetic discipline, continence, burnt offerings, rituals, worships, char­ity etc.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਦਸੈ ਨ ਦਸਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: nira(n)kaar na pachhaaniaa saadhasa(n)gat dhasai na dhasaae|

en.bdb: None has identified the formless Lord, because only holy congre­gation explains about the Lord but none goes there to ask about Him.
People talk and hear about Him only on the basis of heresay (no one moves on the way of experience).
